_: The ceiling of cut-off text the gate tolerates today, per platform and fingerprint (Feature #298). A count over the ceiling fails the gate; a count under it is a stale baseline the gate reports and does not fail, because a count varies run to run on a loaded runner (Issue #1103). It only shrinks, unless a change widens the sweep: a raised count then needs a new reason under raised, keyed by fingerprint and checked against the committed version and the base a pull request merges into. Once a lower count holds, run node scripts/cutoff-sweep.mjs --lower on each platform and commit the lowered counts. A platform with no section is seeded by its first --lower; CI runs linux, and a red gate prints the linux counts it measured.
